us_gaap_RevenueRemainingPerformanceOblig.description: This table outlines the revenue sources, descriptions, performance obligations, timing of revenue recognition, and payment terms for regulated electric and gas tariff sales and regulated transmission services.

revenue_source: Regulated Electric and Gas Tariff Sales
description: Sales of electricity and electricity distribution services (the Utility Registrants) and natural gas and gas distribution services (PECO, BGE, and DPL) to residential, commercial, industrial, and governmental customers through regulated tariff rates approved by state regulatory commissions.

The Utility Registrants provide open access to their transmission facilities to PJM, which directs and controls the operation of these transmission facilities and accordingly compensates the Utility Registrants pursuant to filed tariffs at cost-based rates approved by FERC.
performance_obligation: Delivery of electricity and/or natural gas.
Various including (i) Network Integration Transmission Services ("NITS"), (ii) scheduling, system control and dispatch services, and (iii) access to the wholesale grid.
timing_of_revenue_recognition: Over time (each day) as the electricity and/or natural gas is delivered to customers. Tariff sales are generally considered daily contracts as customers can discontinue service at any time.
Over time utilizing output methods to measure progress towards completion.
payment_terms: Within the month following delivery of the electricity or natural gas to the customer.
